jacobian_asymmetry.definition: ||J - J^T||_F / ||J||_F per state; 0 = exact gradient field
jacobian_asymmetry.note: Symmetry is expected in PC coordinates because the teacher drift is grad_x mu. In z coordinates the per-axis scales break symmetry even for an exact distillation, so J_z asymmetry alone must not be quoted as structure loss.

scope: Frozen committed symbolic models only. Probe initial states are synthetic shell points, not observed cells; results diagnose the fitted field, they do not replicate the validation protocol of src/validate.py.
